newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Bel-20 record run to rumble on - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Bel-20 record run to rumble on - dealers.

text.p: 1700 GMT - Bel-20 share index looks set to continue its record-busting run on the back of a strong dollar, underpinning export-oriented stocks, historically low interest rates, low inflation and support from Wall Street, dealers said.
* Dow Jones up 35 points late in U.S. morning.
* One trader said PetroFina, UCB should continue to benefit from analysts' liking for pharma, petro-chemicals, petro-chemical service companies.
* Wednesday's Bel-20 close above 2,531.11 (up 1.66 pct) bodes well for further gains, a trader said.
* Another said rise might slow down as players wait for confirmation of current P/Es from first-half earnings reports.
